verdict.rationale: Vue is a library that is driven entirely through its programmatic JavaScript API. The vendor claims an 'intuitive API and world-class documentation', and a community comment praises Vue's redesigned public API. A live llms.txt also gives AI agents a machine-readable index of the docs. The OpenAPI 404s don't count against it, since Vue has no hosted service for an OpenAPI spec to describe. Missing for 10: a cited API reference page showing the depth of the public API surface, and hands-on evidence of an AI agent actually driving Vue through it.
